issues.reason: *Coordination & plurals* reserves a bare (Member <group> <prop>) for a property genuinely of the collection itself and records the members' kind with (GroupOf <group> <kind>), so (Member sk_group_1 pedotransfer_function) predicates the members' kind of the group-as-object.

*Thematic roles* puts a prepositional verb's object in the preposition's oblique — 'referred **to** the memo' is the instruction set's own example — and a passive carries exactly the roles its active would, so the subject requires (To sk_refer_1 sk_group_1); sealing is finite-clause-only and 'as pedotransfer functions' is no finite clause.
The sealed term carries the same (Member <group> <member-kind>) mis-predication, and it goes with the seal.

The top-level atom asserts the designation unrestrictedly while the sentence bounds it to a non-spatial context — the same over-assertion *Conditional properties* bars when it forbids stripping a restriction from a kind-level claim.

gaps_confirmed: naming / designation predicates ('are referred to as Y', 'is called / known as / termed Y') and the 'as'-phrase they take have no encoding
how a class-designation applies to a definite PLURAL group (per-member vs group-level) is unspecified, given that Member on a group symbol is barred and GroupOf is presented as the member-kind slot
new_gaps: a restriction on a designation ('in a non-spatial context') can only ride the reified event — there is no licensed way to record a *restricted* class membership for a group or for its members
repair_summary: Replaced the sealed Theme term with the prepositional-verb oblique (To sk_refer_1 sk_group_1), giving the passive subject the role its active would have. Carried the designation as the surface-preposition oblique (As sk_refer_1 pedotransfer_function) so it stays inside the restricted referring event. Dropped the top-level (Member sk_group_1 pedotransfer_function), which both mis-predicated the members' kind of the group and asserted the naming unrestrictedly.
notes: (As …) is the preposition actually used, which the preposition-named-oblique licence covers, and it records the designation without asserting it at large. Everything else is untouched — group witness, predictive_function fusion plus modifier genus, withheld pedotransfer modifier genus, the In framing oblique and the tenseless generic present.
